conviction_note: There is no pre-release and the company gives no guidance. The only published 2026 forecast (Noble, July) implies H2 EBITDA of about 20m PLN after a Q2 miss (0.6 vs 4.0 PAP consensus), which is a step-up the business has not shown. Q3 grant seasonality beat consensus heavily in both 2024 and 2025, and the stock sold off both times. So the findings roughly offset (sum -0.2). The scaled number is a small negative lean (p_up 46) on a 5.5% move, taken from this name's 'beats sold, misses punished' reaction history. The two numbers agree in sign and size because neither has a decisive sourced fact behind it.

findings.why_not_priced: Only partly unpriced. The stock is already -22.8% over 20 days and -31.8% over 60, which looks like a market that has marked down the H2 recovery. If the step-up were fully priced out, a merely in-line Q3 would leave the sell-side bar above the print with nothing left to fall. The PAP Q3 consensus is not visible, so the size of the remaining gap is an inference from a single broker. Capped small for that reason.

findings.finding: Q3 has been Celon's big-surprise quarter in both prior years: Q3 2024 EBITDA was 69.8m vs a 3.9m PAP consensus and Q3 2025 EBITDA 30.3m vs 8.9m, driven by milestone and grant income. findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Both Q3 beats were sold: Q3 2024 (revenue +99.7% vs consensus) opened +4.7% and closed -5.28% on 2024-11-21; Q3 2025 (EBITDA 30.3 vs 8.9) closed -3.02% on 2025-11-20.

findings.why_not_priced: Grant timing is not visible to the market until the report: PAP consensus missed Q3 EBITDA by a factor of three in 2025 and eighteen in 2024. Had a grant-driven Q3 been priced, the stock would not have drifted 23% lower into the print. Sized small because grant and milestone beats are one-offs this name's holders have sold twice.

baseline_tension: The findings net to about zero against a lean of +1.14 (a -22.8% run-up read as mean reversion). The small negative scaled number cuts mildly against the free control, and rests only on the name's history of selling beats and punishing misses, not on a sourced unpriced number.

lessons_applied: 'A beat made of a one-off is sold' (H&M): the Q3 grant-seasonality finding cut from +0.5 to +0.3, and p_up 47 -> 46, since this name sold both earlier grant/milestone Q3 beats.

'Too small about the move' and 'size on what is new': abs_move_pct 5.0 -> 5.5, because the numbers are not pre-released and turnover is thin ($131k/day). It is held below the 7% European base because no guidance is given (2.3% median for none) and the name's own print reactions run 0.2-5.3%.
